description: This file defines the AWS\PCS\PCSClient class, a client for interacting with the AWS Parallel Computing Service (PCS). It includes method signatures for managing clusters, compute node groups, queues, tags, and resources, with both synchronous and asynchronous variants.

classes.name: Aws\PCS\PCSClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with AWS Parallel Computing Service, providing methods to manage clusters, compute node groups, queues, tags, and resources with both sync and async options.

methods.name: createCluster
methods.description: Creates a new AWS Parallel Computing Service cluster.

methods.name: createClusterAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new AWS Parallel Computing Service cluster.

methods.name: createComputeNodeGroup
methods.description: Creates a new compute node group within a cluster.

methods.name: createComputeNodeGroupAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new compute node group within a cluster.

methods.name: createQueue
methods.description: Creates a new queue for job management.

methods.name: createQueueAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new queue.

methods.name: deleteCluster
methods.description: Deletes an existing cluster.

methods.name: deleteClusterAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a cluster.

methods.name: deleteComputeNodeGroup
methods.description: Deletes a compute node group.

methods.name: deleteComputeNodeGroupAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a compute node group.

methods.name: deleteQueue
methods.description: Deletes a queue.

methods.name: deleteQueueAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a queue.

methods.name: getCluster
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific cluster.

methods.name: getClusterAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details of a specific cluster.

methods.name: getComputeNodeGroup
methods.description: Retrieves details of a compute node group.

methods.name: getComputeNodeGroupAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details of a compute node group.

methods.name: getQueue
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific queue.

methods.name: getQueueAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details of a specific queue.

methods.name: listClusters
methods.description: Lists all clusters.

methods.name: listClustersAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists all clusters.

methods.name: listComputeNodeGroups
methods.description: Lists all compute node groups.

methods.name: listComputeNodeGroupsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists all compute node groups.

methods.name: listQueues
methods.description: Lists all queues.

methods.name: listQueuesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists all queues.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags for a given resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: registerComputeNodeGroupInstance
methods.description: Registers an instance with a compute node group.

methods.name: registerComputeNodeGroupInstanceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously registers an instance with a compute node group.

methods.name: tagResource
methods.description: Adds tags to a resource.

methods.name: tagResourceAsync

methods.name: untagResource
methods.description: Removes tags from a resource.
